cases.description: Expose quiet/suppressLogs in project_manage tool schema.
cases.prompt:
Update the `project_manage` tool inputSchema so it supports two optional boolean properties at the top-level: `quiet` and `suppressLogs`. Keep the existing style/formatting and do not change behavior.

Update the `manage` parameters table in the tool reference docs to document `quiet` and `suppressLogs` as optional booleans used to suppress reindex logging.

Return ONLY JSON.

Add a new `project_manage` command `reindex_status`.

1) Update the `project_manage` command enum to include `reindex_status`.
2) Implement `case 'reindex_status'` in the manage handler that returns exactly this shape (match strings exactly):

{ success: true, output: "Reindex status", activity: { reindexInProgress: this.reindexInProgress, lastReindex: this.reindexLastResult } }

3) Update the tool reference to mention `manage({ command: "reindex_status" })` and that it reports `reindexInProgress` and `lastReindex`.
4) Update the agent playbook tip about reindexing and the getting-started reindex guidance to mention `manage({ command: "reindex_status" })` as the way to check progress.

Do not add other fields. Return ONLY JSON.

cases.description: Add a --workspace alias for --root and document it.
cases.prompt:
Add support for a `--workspace` flag as an alias for `--root`. It must support both `--workspace /path` and `--workspace=/path`.

Update the main README Quickstart to show the new `--workspace` example next to the existing `--root` example.
Update the getting-started guide “Run from this repo” block to include the same `--workspace` example on its own line right after the `--root` line.
Update the configuration guide’s Project & Root table to mention the `--workspace` CLI alias.

Return ONLY JSON.

cases.description: Add a --allow-cwd-root flag for broad-root startup and document it.
cases.prompt:
Add support for a `--allow-cwd-root` flag that acts as a CLI alias for `KAIRO_ALLOW_CWD_ROOT=true`.

Requirements:
- It must support all of:
  - `--allow-cwd-root` (implies true)
  - `--allow-cwd-root=true|false`
  - `--allow-cwd-root true|false`
- If the flag is provided, it must override the `KAIRO_ALLOW_CWD_ROOT` env var.
- Do not change existing behavior when the flag is not provided.

Docs:
- Update README Quickstart to mention `--allow-cwd-root` as the override when Kairo refuses to start due to a broad root.
- Update the getting-started “Run from this repo” block to include an example line using `--allow-cwd-root`.
- Update the configuration guide Common env vars table to include `KAIRO_ALLOW_CWD_ROOT` and mention the `--allow-cwd-root` CLI alias.

Return ONLY JSON.

cases.description: Add a --kairo-dir alias for KAIRO_DIR and document it.
cases.prompt:
Add support for a `--kairo-dir` flag that acts as a CLI alias for the `KAIRO_DIR` env var.

Requirements:
- It must support both `--kairo-dir /path` and `--kairo-dir=/path`.
- If the flag is provided, it must override the `KAIRO_DIR` env var.
- Do not change behavior when the flag is not provided.

Docs:
- Update README to document `--kairo-dir` as a CLI alternative for setting the data directory.
- Update the getting-started “Run from this repo” block to include a `--kairo-dir .kairo` example.
- Update the configuration guide Common env vars table row for `KAIRO_DIR` to mention the `--kairo-dir` CLI alias.

Return ONLY JSON.

cases.description: Warn when warmup is skipped due to an empty index.
cases.prompt:
Improve observability for warmup behavior.

In `shouldWarmupSearchIndex()`, when `indexedFiles === 0` and warmup is skipped because `KAIRO_WARMUP_ON_EMPTY_INDEX` is not enabled, emit a single `console.warn(...)` explaining that warmup was skipped due to an empty index and that the user can set `KAIRO_WARMUP_ON_EMPTY_INDEX=true` or reindex first.

Update the configuration guide to document warmup-related env vars in the Search & Results area by adding a small table that includes `KAIRO_WARMUP_ENABLED`, `KAIRO_WARMUP_MAX_FILES`, and `KAIRO_WARMUP_ON_EMPTY_INDEX` with short descriptions.

Do not change the return values/logic beyond adding this warning. Return ONLY JSON.
